authoritative_evidence.meaning: single-transaction production SELECT-only authority and EVID-02 ledger inventory
EVID-02 approval and activation heads are empty
disposable local PostgreSQL software evidence only; not production acceptance
STRAT-01 candidate-bound zero-seed owner ledger report

required_review_parties.evidence_authority_subject_owner: real named owner using a production account
required_review_parties.independent_root_approver: real human staff account with the exact approver role
required_review_parties.independent_reviewer: person and production account distinct from the root approver
required_review_parties.strategy_business_owners: named accountable owner for each approved R1-R8 definition
required_review_parties.operations_owner: authorizes bounded production writes and PostgreSQL acceptance

phase_gates.title: Authorize real Account authority and owner-assignment upstream seals
required_inputs: real subject owner identity and production account
actor/auth-context/user/RBAC source identities and exact content hashes
assignment evidence identity, version and expected content hash
stop_if: any upstream head is missing, superseded, expired, cross-alias or hash-mismatched
identity or account namespace is inferred from mutable User, Profile or session state
subject and approver are not independent

phase_gates.title: Issue one exact owner/tenant authority root
required_post_write_receipts: duplicate attempt conflict or exact idempotent replay result

phase_gates.title: Issue a Research evidence scope source from an exact approved observation
required_inputs: owner_id, tenant_id, account_id and actor_id proven by exact-current authority
artifact owner, type, id, version and content hash
required_post_write_receipts: owner/tenant authority and scope content-hash binding

phase_gates.title: Register, approve and activate a real evidence operator definition
required_inputs: owner record id, version and content hash
validity window, invalidation condition and rollback approval path
post_write_head_requirements: one approval root and one current head
one activation root and one current head
activation references the exact approval hash
operator identity, version and definition hash do not drift

phase_gates.title: Run bounded production PostgreSQL concurrency and rollback acceptance
required_cases: outer transaction rollback leaves zero partial rows
revoked or expired head does not fall back to an older row
same-alias end-to-end authority and Evidence read
authorization_boundaries: operations owner and independent reviewer receipts

phase_gates.title: Approve authoritative business inputs for R1 through R8
required_fields_per_capability: named business owner and production account
definition id, version, document reference and SHA-256
policy id, version and decision rules
calendar id, version, timezone and cutoff semantics
scope id, version, universe reference and universe hash
minimum sample window, periods, sample count and coverage threshold
qualification id, version and falsification thresholds
benchmark, cost, liquidity and label semantics when applicable
validity window and owner approval receipt

phase_gates.title: Authorize append-only registration only after canonical dry-run
required_before_authorization: stop conditions and successor or revocation rollback plan

post_execution_reviews_not_preapprovable: EVID authority, scope, approval and activation current-head audit
production PostgreSQL first-winner, successor, revocation and rollback evidence
same-alias end-to-end receipts and independent sign-off
STRAT owner-ledger exact rows and content hashes
Promotion, consumer UAT and rollback acceptance
global_stop_conditions: candidate commit, release, image or database alias drift
placeholder, synthetic, fixture or proxy-signed identity
scope or identity inferred from mutable user/session state
unapproved production write or expanded subject set
attempt to clear the global decision or execution deny before all dependent gates pass
next_action: Obtain separate finalized EVID and STRAT review returns. No production write is executable until the exact phase decision, real identities, receipts, validity window and dependencies are validated.
